title: Item
description: An item entity. One entity per file, conventionally content/items/<id>.json.

portable.description: Whether the item can be picked up into the player's inventory.

icon.description: Path to the item's inventory icon asset, relative to the content package root.

combinesWithItemIds.description: References other content/items/*.json entities this item can be combined with.

interactions.description: Script(s) run when the player interacts with this item.
